test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
This question is based on the five, three-digit numbers given below.

(Left) 411 559 916 247 769 (Right)

(Example- 697 – First digit = 6, second digit = 9 and third digit = 7) (NOTE: All operations to be done from left to right.)

What will be the resultant if the first digit of the lowest number is subtracted from the first digit of the highest number?
solution:
Given: (Left) 411 559 916 247 769 (Right)

According to the question:

 
 

 Given numbers
 411
 559
 916
 247
 769
 
 

 Number are arranged in ascending order
 247
 411
 559
 769
 916
 
 

So,

First digit of the highest number → __9__16 → 2

First digit of the lowest number → __2__47 → 9

Thus, if the first digit of the lowest number is subtracted from the first digit of the highest number then the resultant will be → 9 - 2 → 7 

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
